generated.details: Its padded seat and back join low upholstered arms above short feet.
One cream textured cushion has a softly filled, seam-edged woven cover and leans against the sofa back.
Far left against the rear wall, the low oak sideboard has a rectangular carcass, fitted doors and short supporting legs.
Above it, the woven fiber wall piece hangs from a wooden rod, its interlaced natural strands ending in loose fringe.
Mid-plane right on the tabletop, folded reading glasses have two rimmed lenses joined by a bridge, with hinged temples folded inward.
Beside them, a shallow ceramic fruit bowl has a continuous curved rim and stable foot holding apples and pears.
